comment: GRDLOOP (was Looper) - a bar-synced stereo looper on the MOD firmware's song grid (bar 1 = MIDI Start, or the press that records when no clock runs). Footswitch: with the MIDISTOMP looper services the firmware counts presses (footswitch on the looper, its on/off CC 64-127) and the looper drives the LED; without them every on/off flip is a press: press records (Sync OWN: until a second press, whole cycles; SLAVE: one cycle) when empty, then stops / plays the loop; a double press deletes it at once. Record, stop and play wait for Next (NOW, BEAT, BAR, CYC = the next Cycle-bar line). Roll repeats the last 1/2..1/32 of a bar from the next bar line, latched. Mix crossfades live and loop. 12-bit block floating point; stereo whenever a cycle fits, else mono (L+R)/2, else shorter (REC n/m). Tempo changes: the loop stays on the grid (re-synced on 1/32 lines, pitch unchanged).
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox, 493 Breather, 495 GridDly, 496 Sweep, 497 Looper (this pack; 492 and 494 were used by dropped effects, 498 and 499 by the probes). Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.
audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Crossfade live <-> loop, DJ style: live full up to 50, loop full from 50, both full at 50. With no loop playing only the live part is heard (Mix 100 = silence). In Mixer Mode's Parallel mode keep it at 100 and use [MIX]'s Crossfade. Default 50.

params.name: Roll
params.comment: OFF, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32 of a bar (no triplets). Latched beat repeat: starts on the next bar line and repeats the last slice of the bar that was playing; a new rate takes over on its next line; OFF lands on the running rate's next line, where the loop would have been. Default OFF.

params.name: Sync
params.comment: OWN: record from the Next line until the Next line after the second press, rounded up to whole cycles. SLAVE: record one cycle, then play. Old Looper patches: Length 2 bars reads as SLAVE, every other Length as OWN. Default OWN.

params.name: Next
params.comment: When record, stop and play land: NOW (a single press waits 300 ms for a possible double press), BEAT, BAR, CYC (the next cycle start counted from bar 1). Delete (double press) is always at once. Old patches' When maps 1:1 (IMMED = NOW). Default CYC.

params.name: Cycle
params.comment: Cycle length, shown as 1 to 32 bars. Perform mode's CYCLE (looper services word 21) overrides it when set. Old patches' Amount (1-16 bars) maps 1:1. Default 8 bars.

params.name: Stop
params.comment: KEEP: MIDI Stop and clock loss are ignored, the loop plays on at the last tempo and waiting actions keep waiting; the next MIDI Start restarts the loop at bar 1. HALT: MIDI Stop stops the loop and drops waiting actions; Start plays it from bar 1. Default KEEP.
